name: Petrify
description: Petrify device discovery, playback handoff and listening-party relay.
overview: Runs the bundled Petrify relay with Jellyfin, with validated network and party timing settings and an optional browser health check.

versions.changelog: Relay 1.2.4: republishes the current voting and reaction-enabled relay so installations can update from legacy 1.0.7 builds; health reports voting, queue management, independent voting and reaction capabilities, and plugin settings identify outdated or incorrectly routed relay URLs.
